title: Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarships
about: TU Delft scholarships for international applicants (conditionally) admitted to a 2-year regular TU Delft MSc programme. At least 16 are awarded each year. The complete MSc and scholarship application is due 1 December 2026 (23:59 CET).
card_alt: Black EduCut Connect card for the Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarships at Delft University of Technology (TU Delft), Delft, Netherlands, deadline 1 Dec 2026. The photo shows colourful gabled canal houses and moored boats reflected in a canal in Amsterdam, Netherlands.
